what: PREDICTION WRITTEN BEFORE THE RUN — narration batch 1, fix 3: a multi-arrival volley pays its drain once per arrival, at the arrival's own damage line, instead of once at the foot on the row total.

predictions.why: THE RISKIEST OF THE THREE, and it is asserted rather than assumed: `Math.round` per arrival is not `Math.round` over the sum, so this could move the user's final HP by one. Every arm of tests/probe_drain_per_arrival.js asserts the user's END HP equal on both engines AND `r.stateDiv` empty, in the clean arm and the red one.
three narration-only causes, one game each, are `|-heal|…|[from]drain` against the next line. The band's top is all three transferring.
three removed; a transfer adds one back.
no tag wired, no mechanic added.

named_risks: THE ARITHMETIC IS THE RISK. Per-arrival rounding can differ from one rounding over the sum by one HP. The probe measured the authority's own intermediate value (156 then 172) and this engine now reproduces both, but the pool is 961 games and the probe is four.

A GAME COULD ARRIVE. Adding a `-heal` line where there was none can create an ordering divergence in a game that agreed before, so the count could go UP. That is the direction to watch and it is why the band has no room below 63.
MEDSEEN.drainPaidPerArrival must read ABOVE ZERO on the pinned pool.
